## Findings and bounded direction

| Finding | Disposition and intended result | Boundaries / evidence needed |
| --- | --- | --- |
| OS1-01 | **Accept, first priority.** An explicit pickup or refusal must answer the player's input even during danger. Request one compact transient result near the interaction area, while hazards remain readable. | This deliberately revises the old action-suppression presentation policy. Use typed channel/context, not message parsing. No queued replay, stacked pickup history, saved timer or simulation/economy change. Preserve persistence/system errors, panel-local results, actor/session/reset behavior and accessible announcements. Verify low air, food/power, full hold, active threat and save failure together. |
| OS1-02 | **Accept affordance gap; no targeting defect established.** A centred visible host just beyond reach should say “Move closer”, without an E/Q affordance. Improve bracket value contrast. | Keep execution reach strictly below4m and existing LOS/host/tie rules. A bounded presentation preview up to8m must never become an executable target or shadow an available in-reach action. Share selection logic, preserve own-host solids and opening/pilot/interior gates. No remote scan, discovery, through-wall marker or spoiler reveal. |
| OS1-03 | **Accept.** Put useful local storage/fitting/service actions before cargo transfers. Compact item rows with explicit Move disclosure; state each module tradeoff once and use consistent cruise terminology. | Preserve semantic focus, native Tab, disclosure/session reset, item identity/provenance, explicit destination intent and departed-site reset. Show an unavailable action's useful prerequisite where needed; do not hide the player's next step. Show one concise outcome. Recount the same earned refit at960×600; aim for no scroll to Store/Install without hiding essential costs/capacity. |
| OS1-04 | **Accept redundant warning and ambiguous glyph; narrow remedy.** Keep current hazard information and a short emitted-call cue, suppress duplicate threat prose. Separate bearing from elevation clearly. | The glyph encodes horizontal compass direction, so this is ambiguous visual semantics, not proven bad source math. Ask for the simplest readable cue; no new world pulse, shader or creature tracking. Retain detached origin/finite lifetime and release/refuge reset. Keep pulse cost/availability and useful non-threat guidance; “two surfaces” is a target for duplicate warning prose, not a ban on vital safety information. |
| OS1-05 | **Accept service discoverability.** Indicate service support before the player feels forced to dock. Investigate sustained blocked thrust narrowly before promising a cue. | Use authoritative service predicates; distinguish supported site from disabled-hull/occupancy/player-access refusals. Do not imply free service anywhere inside a radius. Reviewer tooling does not prove a geometry defect. If a real collision-limited thrust cue is justified, specify measured transient evidence and false-positive exclusions. No velocity-only stall heuristic, auto-docking, steering/physics/geometry changes or decorative lane work in this batch. |
| OS1-06 | **Accept readability, overlap and duplicate-hint work.** Set readable secondary type, reserve non-overlapping prompt/result space at960/1280 and keep one control hint. | Prefer stable controls; defer auto-fading five toolbar buttons. Keep explicit capture/fallback affordance usable after denial or loss; do not remove it just because a timer expired. Preserve deliberate resume, context-loss preparation and async cancellation. Consolidated hazard presentation should remove stale duplicate numeric readings. |
| OS1-07 | **Accept concise fabrication/readiness improvements with recovery correction.** Distinguish ready from unavailable actions, retain an adjacent reason, use “cockpit side”, and give trim a brief next step. | Dart is intentionally `once:false` so it can be rebuilt after salvage. An existing hull can appear as built/currently owned, but must become craftable again when rules allow; never mark it permanently completed from crafted history. Do not claim a moving/disabled hull is still in its cradle. Inspect focus before changing the accepted validated service-to-panel behavior; first-ready focus is optional advice, not an automatic requirement. |
| OS1-08 | **Accept small copy cleanup; narrow lifecycle changes.** Remove repeated pod footer/routine meta prose, use Cargo if coherent, remove the inaccurate pause subtitle and seated “0m away”. | Preserve lore/captions, useful optional-log guidance, recovery and persistence warnings. Keep the carrier diagnostic accessible for development with honest labelling; a full debug-menu rework can wait. Escape-to-resume is deferred: the current captured-look and interruption safeguards are intentional. Explicit Return remains available; no input-policy rewrite here. |

Depth contrast, near-field motion cues, visible ecology and cockpit visual balance remain M2 benchmark-region/art priorities. Retain them in that milestone; no seat/handling/fog rewrite belongs to this correction. The approximately ten-hour full campaign and all fleet/region dependencies remain unchanged.
